question: q27
gold_sql: SELECT T2.CDSCode, T2.School, T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.Phone FROM schools AS T2 LEFT JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', T2.ClosedDate) < '2000'
verdict: gold 口径自洽（人群=日期命中的全部学校，LEFT 保留缺 SAT 学校，NULL 分数；键两侧唯一、无扇出）。INNER/前导零/去重均属更强解释跳跃，金标不动，登记已知尖角。
